$comment: Capability-owned routing cases. A null expectedTool means another capability or raw source access is preferable.

cases.request: This 140-page PDF is expensive to reread. Create a reusable structured representation with provenance.
cases.reason: A bounded PDF should be preprocessed once for progressive access.

cases.request: Give me the cheapest overview and counts for the document I just optimized.
cases.reason: The manifest includes the deterministic summary, status, and structural counts.

cases.request: Show me the heading hierarchy and which sections contain tables.
cases.reason: The paginated outline is the lowest-cost way to select detail.

cases.request: Read only section-004-runtime-contract from this optimized document.
cases.reason: The caller already selected one section and should not receive the full document.

cases.request: Return table-002 as structured rows so I can compare listener settings.
cases.reason: Structured cells are preferable to flattened text or an image.

cases.request: What caption, dimensions, and source page are recorded for figure-003?
cases.reason: Figure metadata should be inspected before requesting raster bytes.

cases.request: Search every document in the company corpus for this deployment setting.
cases.reason: Corpus retrieval belongs to Doc RAG, not Document Optimizer.

cases.request: Interpret the arrows and service relationships in this architecture diagram.
cases.reason: Semantic image interpretation belongs to Vision.

cases.request: Render the original PDF page exactly as pixels for legal comparison.
cases.reason: Exact page rendering and binary fidelity require a raw/source rendering tool.
